stage: prospective repetition after exploratory diagnostics; not blind discovery
component: Claude Code mod test engine and public built-in module source
researcher_constraint: No account, no login, no paid model calls

design.criterion: Instruction fallback, unreadable walk, import/content deduplication, directory boundary and managed filtering meet authored contracts. Three tests exercise engine hooks; five directly exercise public source helpers.

On Windows the literal POSIX fs.list stub misses canonical drive paths. The portable virtual-fixture stub must show unavailable during merge and changed after merge. The no-marker control must show ordinary changes.
design.classification_if_control_succeeds: test-fixture platform mismatch; not a confirmed production client failure
design.ablation: Change only the fs.list virtual path matching; retain client, public mod source, Git responses, clock and UI flow.

exploratory_results.upstream_diff: 207 pass / 3 fail; all three use a literal /work/.git fs.list stub
exploratory_results.diff_path_probe: Both literal and slash-only stubs fail; observed requests are C:\work\.git. Adding drive adaptation is a prospective fixture control.

full_suite_control.change: Only tests/register.test.ts fs.list matching for the virtual /work/.git fixture; normalize separators and drive prefix. No hooks implementation changes.
full_suite_control.expected: All 210 upstream tests pass if the three exploratory failures are fixture path mismatches.

prospective_amendment.reason: The test engine does not expose a process global. A 10-repeat diagnostic batch had one ReferenceError test failure per repetition despite valid logged observations and two passing cases. Exclude that batch from contract-pass totals.
prospective_amendment.change: Remove process.platform from the authored assertion and restrict the runner's authored diff diagnostic to native Windows, as already covered by this protocol.
prospective_amendment.remaining_observation_status: Exploratory only; retained privately and summarized publicly, never counted as product failures.

limitations: The four public mods are not the full proprietary implementation.
World interactions are scripted by the official test engine; this is component-contract evidence.
Deterministic repetitions check stability, not independent model draws or a population failure rate.
No claim of Claude model instruction retention, long-horizon performance or production diff failure is supported.
No official issue or release is justified by this diagnostic alone.
count_unit: Test-case executions, not individual expect assertions or independent coding trials; final authored batches are 11 distinct cases repeated 10 times.
